_note: HAND-WRITTEN (27 October 2026). This archive's own answer to 'which country is this place in today' for a ribbon card whose place the kit will not place by itself (kit docs/ribbon-flags.md, the --countries file of ribbonflags.py). {card place text, as the card prints it, without a leading 'of ': ISO country code, or null for no flag}. Only a place this archive's own evidence settles is given a country, and the evidence is under _evidence; a place it does not settle is null and says why. It decides TODAY's flag only: the era flag comes from the era table alone (flag-places.json), so nothing here can put a flag of the war years on a card.

_evidence.Hammerstein: Hammerstein, West Prussia, is Czarne in powiat człuchowski, Poland: data/era/ground.tsv 'Hammerstein, Westpreußen, Germany now Poland' and 'Hammerstein (Czarne)'; data/geneteka-pomorskie-2026-10-11.tsv 'Hammerstein is CZARNE in powiat człuchowski'. The era table deliberately gives it no region (Kreis Schlochau stayed German in 1920), so today's flag only.
_evidence.Allenstein: Allenstein is Olsztyn, Poland: data/era/ground.tsv 'Allenstein (Olsztyn)'; data/surname-lines.tsv 'Standesamt OLSZTYN-ALLENSTEIN'. The era snapshot holds it silent (within 15 km of the East Prussia ring's edge), so today's flag only.
_evidence.Sauerbaum: Sauerbaum, Kreis Rössel, is Zerbuń, Gmina Jeziorany, powiat olsztyński, Poland: data/ermland-sauerbaum.tsv row 18 'SAUERBAUM, Kreis Rößel, East Prussia = ZERBUŃ, today in GMINA JEZIORANY, POWIAT OLSZTYŃSKI'; data/corrections.json (Zerbuń's coordinates). East Prussia lies in three countries today, so the region alone cannot say which.
_evidence.Sauerbaum, East Prussia: The same Sauerbaum (Zerbuń, Poland), as the story's card prints it.
_evidence.Berlin Schöneberg: Schöneberg, a district of Berlin, Germany: data/era/ground.tsv 'Schöneberg, Berlin, Germany' and 'Berlin-Schöneberg'.
_evidence.Treplice: NOT SETTLED: data/era/ground.tsv 'Treplice (bei Zinnwald)': 'the name is shared by several places, or is a spelling the data does not settle'. No flag.
_evidence.Lourenço Marques: Lourenço Marques is Maputo, Mozambique (data/era/ground.tsv 'Lourenso Margues, Mozambique'), but the kit carries no flag of Mozambique, so there is none to draw: null.
_evidence.Newington: Newington, Surrey (now London): english-people.json, William Wear 'c.1823, Walworth or Newington, Surrey'; John and Elizabeth Wear on baptism transcripts at Newington.
_evidence.Walworth or Newington, Surrey: Both in Newington parish, Surrey (now London): english-people.json 'Walworth is a district inside Newington parish'. One country either way.
_evidence.Deptford or Bermondsey: english-people.json: Sarah Bloom's birthplace 'Deptford, Kent' in 1851 and 'Bermondsey, Surrey' in 1871. The two counties differ, the country does not.
_evidence.Bermondsey: Bermondsey, Surrey (now London): english-people.json, the 1851 census 'At Bermondsey (HO107 piece 1560)'; 'Bermondsey in Surrey in 1871'.
_evidence.St Olave, Bermondsey: St Olave, Southwark registration district, Surrey (now London): english-people.json 'Q3 1889, St Olave, Bermondsey'; 'At St Olave, Southwark, vol 1D'.
_evidence.Baldock district: Baldock registration district, Hertfordshire: english-people.json, Martha Giddings 'c.1841, Baldock district'.
